Description: Host Building Structural Adequacy & Physical Inspection
Trigger_Condition: Unverified parent building framing slab punching shear or hidden distress under canopy reactions
Release_Prerequisite: Signed physical structural inspection report crack mapping and NDT rebound hammer/UPV logs certified by RSE Grade-I/II per TNCDBR-2019 Rule 35
Notes: Mandatory physical inspection hold. Prevents construction without site structural audit.

Description: Aerodynamic Wind Tunnel & CFD Pressure Calibration
Trigger_Condition: Canopy array tilt geometry or micro-turbulent parapet wake interactions outside codal tables
Release_Prerequisite: Boundary layer wind tunnel (BLWT) test report or peer-reviewed CFD matching full-scale canopy geometry per IS 875(3) Cl 8.3 / ASCE 49-21 / SEAOC PV2
Notes: Elevated canopy governed by net pressure Table 8; wake turbulence requires BLWT if tilt exceeds 15 deg.

Description: Geographic Coordinates & Regional Wind Zone Verification
Trigger_Condition: Unverified basic wind speed Vb or cyclonic factor k4 near administrative/coastal boundaries
Release_Prerequisite: Official municipal survey records or verified geocoding report matching IS 875(3) Appendix A and Figure 1 with 5 km coastal buffer check
Notes: Elevated canopy wind design speed governs column foundation overturning and rafter flexure.

Description: 3D Wind Vector Transformation & Accidental Torsion Gate
Trigger_Condition: Normal module aerodynamic pressures transformed into global Cartesian frame with accidental torsion e = 0.10*b
Release_Prerequisite: Direction cosine transformation verification report and accidental torsion design checks with vector force balance
Notes: Canopy rafter biaxial bending and column torsion depend on spatial component transformation.

Trigger_Condition: Screening of 7 statutory triggers under IS 1893:2016 Clause 6.3.3.1 (Amd 2) vs voluntary project conservatism
Release_Prerequisite: Documented classification under IS 1893(1):2016 Cl 6.3.3.1 determining whether 24 permutations are statutory or project-conservatism
Notes: Elevated canopies in Zone IV/V or with large cantilevers trigger vertical seismic analysis.

Description: Limit State Load Combinations Dual-Gate Check
Trigger_Condition: Traceability of partial safety factors for simultaneous array live walkway live and dedicated erection load rows
Release_Prerequisite: Traceability matrix verifying all ULS and SLS combinations against IS 800:2007 Table 4 with dedicated erection row (1.2 DL + 1.2 ER)
Notes: Primary rafters carry simultaneous array live load (ACT-IL-02) and walkway live load (ACT-IL-04).

Trigger_Condition: Sliding stability of unanchored mounting systems on roof waterproofing membranes
Release_Prerequisite: Certified static pull-slip friction testing per EN 1990:2002 Annex D establishing design friction mu_d under wet and dry conditions
Notes: Applies exclusively to System D (Ballasted). System A uses mechanical post-installed anchor bolts into host columns/slab.

Description: Aluminium Section Modulus & Coupon Tensile Testing
Trigger_Condition: Use of custom extruded aluminium rail profiles without statutory capacity derivation
Release_Prerequisite: Section capacity derivation matching IS 8147:1976 or physical mechanical testing per ASTM B221 / ASTM E8
Notes: Applies to Systems B C and D. System A canopy primary and secondary framing are structural steel (IS 800:2007).

Trigger_Condition: Module clamp slippage or bolt fatigue loosening under dynamic wind buffeting
Release_Prerequisite: Manufacturer-certified torque-tension test curves for stainless steel (A2/A4-70) clamps and calibrated torque-wrench procedure table
Notes: Applies to System A module mid-clamps end-clamps and purlin-to-rafter bolt torque specifications.

Description: FEA Solver Matrix Conditioning & Kinematic Mechanism Gate
Trigger_Condition: Undetected kinematic mechanisms or ill-conditioned stiffness matrices (kappa > 10^8) in 3D frame analysis
Release_Prerequisite: Multi-scale solver benchmark report comparing analytical closed-form solutions against OpenSees/OpenRadioss with patch tests
Notes: Canopy 3D space frame rafter-column stability lateral sway and base fixity require matrix stability checks.

Description: Client Data & Host Building Assumption Sign-Off
Trigger_Condition: Reliance on uncertified customer inputs assumed concrete grades or unverified slab thickness
Release_Prerequisite: Signed client data certification form and verified as-built structural drawing records meeting Level 1 (Measured) or Level 2 (Certified) provenance
Notes: Host building column spacing slab thickness (150mm) and concrete compressive strength (M20) must be certified.

Trigger_Condition: Release of drawings or calculations to fabricators/contractors without statutory RSE stamp per TNCDBR-2019 Rule 38
Release_Prerequisite: Registered Structural Engineer (RSE Grade-I/II) seal signature and structural stability certificate per TNCDBR-2019 Annexure XVII
Notes: Final statutory gate. While active drawing watermark is forced to 'PRELIMINARY — FOR REVIEW ONLY — NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION' and construction status is BLOCKED_AFC_LOCKED.
